description: Covers pyproject/uv.lock, pnpm, GitHub Actions, Dockerfile, .python-version/.tool-versions and prek hooks. Docker images are pinned to digests and GitHub Actions to commit SHAs; Renovate keeps both current.

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates to reduce PR noise
Python runtime: the Docker base image, .python-version and .tool-versions move together in their own PR
Node.js runtime: the Docker base image and .tool-versions move together in their own PR
uv: the Docker image, .tool-versions and the uv_build backend move together in their own PR
onnxruntime >=1.27 ships CUDA 13 wheels, which drop the production GPU (GTX 1080, Pascal). Hold until the GPU base image moves to CUDA 13.
Keep the GPU base image on CUDA 12.6 (see the onnxruntime rule); digest updates only
